gaps.explanation: p6 Exhibit 6 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints four enterprise fund columns (Electric Fund, Water Fund, Gas Fund, Sewer Fund) with no schedule lines in detail[] (Internal Service Fund column excluded). JSON statement receipts = Charge for services + Interest revenue + Miscellaneous revenue (Expense). Per fund: Charge for services 6,313,754 + 1,408,870 + 2,944,442 + 1,150,011 = 11,817,077; Interest revenue 5,326 + 6 + 10,445 + 941 = 16,718; Miscellaneous revenue (Expense) Electric 151,687 + Water 172,692 = 324,379. 11,817,077 + 16,718 + 324,379 = 12,158,174 = statement total = gap. Check: 0 + 12,158,174 = 12,158,174.

The JSON statement records the nonoperating row 'Interest expense / Other Income' Totals (141,329) as an expense of 141,329; per fund it prints Electric (152,383), Water 1,007,091, Gas (996,037), Sewer -. Recorded with the statement's sign convention (printed expense in parentheses = positive expenditure; Water's printed positive income = -1,007,091): 152,383 - 1,007,091 + 996,037 = 141,329. 10,882,888 + 141,329 = 11,024,217 = statement total = gap. Check: 0 + 11,024,217 = 11,024,217.
